verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe off-cycle payroll creation via POST companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls with off_cycle_reason (e.g., Bonus) for corrections/bonuses/terminations, using the same withholding/deductions as regular payrolls but not tied to schedule. This directly matches the story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that off-cycle runs work reliably in production (community evidence is about support/billing issues, not off-cycle payroll functionality specifically), and no detail on termination-specific off-cycle handling beyond generic 'corrections' mention.
